root_cause: The F-SI09 concurrency fixture used a REAL equality solely to assert that identical within-column node parameters produced identical conductivity. The test was compiled with -Werror and compare-reals is correctly diagnosed. This was a test-source correctness defect, not a constitutive formula or source-binding defect.

minimal_repair.change: Replace REAL == comparison with IEEE real64 bit-pattern comparison through transfer(...,int64).

repair_validation.scope: Provider fingerprint O0/O2, real-HeadCalc common-route 1/2/4/8 concurrency, O0/O2 identity and F-SI08 regression before exact-source CI oracle strengthening.
